syllabus.name: HSK 3.0 examination syllabus
syllabus.scope: Complete official shared Levels 7-9 word list; not a separate official Level 7 subset.
syllabus.filename_note: The Level 7 filename is the owner-requested local working name for the combined advanced band.

verification.coverage: All 5,600 printed rows retained in official serial order, including homographs and 443 blank POS cells.

sentences.policy: One newly authored example per official shared Levels 7-9 entry, either conversational or written.

pinyin.word_readings: Exact official HSK spellings, split with the shared frontend aligner; selected target IDs are kept distinct.
pinyin.support: Constrained known-word lexicon plus pypinyin sentence context and jieba boundaries; explicit contextual grammar rules.
pinyin.convention: Word-grouped tone-marked pinyin; contextual 一/不 sandhi; neutral grammatical particles; third-tone dictionary spelling retained. Directional 来/去 retain dictionary tones unless explicitly reviewed; these drafts do not claim to transcribe colloquial recorded surface tones.
pinyin.limitations: Structural alignment proves positional correspondence only. It does not establish independent native review, semantic correctness, source reading correctness, or recorded speech.
pinyin.review_flags: Source conflicts and exposed character/word polyphony remain explicit; supporting dictionary disagreement alone is not proof that the official reading is wrong.

verification.identity_policy: Keep official 7-9 labels and exact version-bound serials. No fabricated separate Level 7 allocation; no changes to existing vocabulary UUIDs or syllabus identities.
